agreement_with_hosted_jev_on_production_.note: bucket agreement on the full 2,631-posting production stream

qwen_lora_finetune.detail: CPU-only host: measured ~13 tok/s training throughput on the 0.5B base at batch 2 / seq 256 (40.7 s per micro-step), i.e. ~10h per epoch over the 2,361-row corpus. Infeasible before the deadline; the frozen-encoder + small-head route reaches a stronger result in minutes.

retrieval_knn_blend.verdict: excluded — actively worse than the head alone
retrieval_knn_blend.note: the blend broke rows the head had right; with 2,579/2,631 neighbours being generic_job the neighbourhood prior swamps rare classes

multi_task_aux_labels.verdict: no gain; kept as a training variant script
multi_task_aux_labels.note: shared trunk supervised on the 5 auxiliary booleans + fit; same four misses

larger_encoder_bge_base.verdict: no gain under the dev-tuned protocol
larger_encoder_bge_base.encoder_blend_logit_space: 66/70 — dev tuning chose weight 0.0 on the small model

evaluation_protocol.gold_set: 70 hand-labelled postings, stratified, held out of training entirely
